I need to decide whether to bid on Oriental Avenue in the auction.

I am weighing whether to bid $76 or drop out. I cannot complete the light blue set without Connecticut, and I need cash for red houses.

A $76 bid would leave me with $171, which is tight. I am now considering whether to bid just to drive up the price and exhaust my opponents' cash.

I decided to drop out. Winning Oriental would waste cash and leave me with an incomplete set. I will let the other players fight over it.
